audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0] told the player to 'Hold W as a defensive stun' and wants.foe[2] said 'Bait your W stun' — Veigar's stun is E; W is Dark Matter and stuns nothing. Full layer never named a Zed ability (packet defect) and breakdown.cooldowns had no digit.
audit.why: Owner kit: only E carries hardCC. Enemy kit: Death Mark 120s rank 1, Living Shadow 20-16s, and R makes him untargetable during the dash — the existing 'answer AFTER the mark lands' advice is correct and kept.
audit.corrected: W-as-stun fixed to E/cage; Death Mark, Living Shadow and his low-health passive named with numbers in the full layer.

audit.why: Death Mark 120s and Living Shadow 20-16s are the lane's timers.

audit.corrected: Rewritten grounded in W-shadow uptime and his execute passive.

audit.why: Nothing verifiable from kits; nothing asserted.

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — Q-stack on cooldown and double-stack off cannon waves. The curve is the matchup.
edits.after: Through 4-5 his W-shadow poke controls trades — your slow spells can't hit him; Q-stack and hold even CS.

edits.before: Primordial Burst online — anyone under half is now a math problem with one answer. Count R damage out loud.
edits.after: At 6 his R dive is your window: self-cage the mark, stun the re-appear, W the stun, and R flips the all-in.

edits.before: Late Veigar IS the scaling argument: cage the choke, burst the carry, and let infinite AP write the closing statement.
edits.after: Two-plus items with Zhonya's up you win every dive he tries: stun the shadow re-appear, stopwatch the mark, R the execute.

edits.before: Zed wins by landing Death Mark, denying your pattern, and starting the fight your kit wanted ten seconds later.
edits.after: Zed wins by chunking you with W-Q shadow poke all lane, then converting the health lead into an untargetable R dive.

edits.before: - Zed Death Mark: matchup-defining — The all-in — spend your defensive answer AFTER the mark lands, not before. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget E Event Horizon (self-cage) for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Death Mark (R) is 120s at rank 1 — spend your answer AFTER the mark lands, never before, and step up hard on its downtime. - Living Shadow (W) is 20-16s: with it down he has no poke range and no escape. - Never swap E's job (emergencies) with R's (kills).

edits.before: Cage his step-up, W the edge-stun, Q-auto, and walk — a half-bar trade that also deposited three stacks into the curve.
edits.after: Dark Matter alone never lands on a Zed with W up — bank it for the stun window your cage buys and the full chunk lands free.

edits.before: W-ing open ground on a moving target and trading uncaged 'just to stack' — Veigar without the wall is a piggy bank with a hat.
edits.after: Under half HP his passive adds bonus magic damage on-hit and Death Mark executes — that stack is worth less than your life.

edits.before: Zed dominates: his Q-E-auto poke with electrocute chunks you every time you step to CS, and he has the mobility to dodge your slow E cage. Hold W as a defensive stun and do not try to trade autos back; just soak XP and farm at max range with Q.
edits.after: Zed dominates: his Q-E-auto poke with electrocute chunks you every time you step to CS, and he has the mobility to dodge your slow E cage. Hold E as your defensive stun and do not trade autos back; just soak XP and farm at max range with Q.

edits.before: Bait your W stun then swap shadows to re-engage
edits.after: Bait your cage stun then swap shadows to re-engage

edits.before: Luden's spike: cage-W-Q-R deletes squishies who touch the wall. Your zone is a courtroom now.
edits.after: First item is his lethality spike — without Zhonya's, his R-Q burst resolves before your combo.

notes: Level chart aligned: full rows 3-6 moved to match content win[] and the packet (which agree); no win[N] edits needed. Content-side W-as-stun errors fixed (E is Veigar's stun). Packet defect 'never names Zed's abilities' addressed in the full layer via enemyWin, cooldowns and phase whys (Death Mark, Living Shadow, lethality/passive). Zed is male; pronouns correct.
